title: Recovery seen on one device: clear it everywhere? (D-4)
detail: When a Writer incident shows verified recovery on your phone, should the acknowledged obligation clear on the desktop too? Today it does not, and the planned fix keeps it that way.
blocks: Nothing urgent; the fix ships with the current behavior.
recommended: Keep per device until the decision state machine (Phase 1) lands.
action: Answer in chat with the option you want; Claude records it in asks/resolved/.
